P05-W01 substantive source audit, 2026-09-09. Existing owner and all four report files are preserved in [repair PR #2581](https://github.com/4444J99/limen/pull/2581), head `cd875d2fd585113cbb12a3ffa2f16d01912ab5a0`, tree `e0a1052d69511ec64aba94942969830e633d1473`.

This review inspected the underlying sources rather than treating the existing Lite Copilot consistency recommendation as exhaustive factual proof. The four-document package at current main `1b8b5f44096d69f562df7e7c893992cad8bf6507` retained the corrected #2568 report, but its early September 8 heavy-denied account had been overtaken by the later same-day execution checkpoint. #2581 repairs that chronology and binds the authorship/proposed-offer statements explicitly.

| Claim group | Source actually inspected | Factual verdict and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| E01: packets, receipts, native identity, isolated lanes, direct-session versus broker authority | AGENTS.md at `26b82ebc65bc2057b39dcef1499edc78308c0489`, including Operating Modes, Peer Conductor, Verification and Integration | Supported as documented protocol. Does not prove universal execution compliance. |
| E02: broker connection and fail-closed availability behavior | `cli/src/limen/conduct/client.py` at the same pinned baseline: authenticated HTTP client, request errors, client_from_env, explicitly local test adapter | Supported as implementation. No live availability or estate-wide outage inference. |
| E03: source-related scoped selection, cheap/heavy separation, bounded command execution | `scripts/verify.py` at the pinned baseline: select, heavy_admission, finite deadline/output handling and execution waves | Supported as mechanism. Selection coverage and historical gate success are separate evidence. |
| E04: heavy-work admission can reject a run | `cli/src/limen/host_admission.py` at the pinned baseline: process identity, pressure reasons, acquire and hold_lease | Supported. Denial is not a test result or quality certificate. |
| E05: declared exact-head single-owner PR integration and alternate queue policy | Pinned concurrent-integration.md and estate.yaml conductor class matching `4444J99/limen` | Supported as registry/policy at that version. No claim that every earlier merge followed it. |
| E06: 111 leaves, 15 phases, 13 chunks, 127 objects; 36 closed versus 35 receipt-valid; three phase parity failures | Snapshot observed `2026-09-08T15:43:16Z`, now pinned in the appendix | Numbers match stored progress/observations. This is a dated audit report, not fresh predicate execution or business completion. |
| E07: false receipt/phase evidence required quarantine | Merged #2481 body and actual invalidation comments `5303837398` / `5303837581` | Supported. Invalidated records remain invalid; their preservation is not rehabilitation. |
| E08: broker unavailable in observed session, changed host admission, partial/failing verification | Actual #2566 comments `5590279757` and `5591987771` | Corrected to latest September 8 checkpoint: heavy admission acquired; CLI 6,720 pass / 126 fail / 16 skip; API 48 pass; later 114-pass import repair resolves 33 failures, leaving 93 earlier failures unverified there. These are executor-reported historical outcomes, not this review's rerun. |
| E09: unchanged authorship statement and proposed Agentic Delivery Audit | Pinned commercial-contract.md and owning commercial-contract.yaml, verified unchanged versus inspected main | Supported as existing policy/proposed offer. No forensic line-authorship, sale, mandate, pricing, adoption or outcome claim. |
| Intended tradeoffs, builder discussion, proposed negative-case demonstration, limitations | E01–E09 and explicit report qualifiers | Tradeoffs describe intended benefits; builder scope is a reasoned interpretation, not an employment title or executive mandate; the demonstration is proposed, not executed. Reliability, ROI, adoption and universal safety guarantees remain withheld. |

The four-file scoped batch exited 0: syntax-changed, diff-hygiene, check-docs-exports, check-note-links all passed. It does not substitute for the factual source audit above. Connector publication reproduced the verified local tree exactly; only commit metadata differs.

The final independent editorial verdict will be recorded separately after review of #2581. A publishable verdict means the bounded source study is fit for owner-controlled publication; it does not authorize external distribution, establish canonical dependencies or satisfy `--verify-work PSP-P05-W01` without the ordinary durable receipt. No marked completion receipt, board transition, publication or task closure was created by this source audit. Root R00/#2566 continues to own controller and acceptance reconciliation.

Independent final editorial verdict — 2026-09-09.

Reviewer: the separate coordinating Codex agent in the current direct-human execution session, independent of the agent who made #2581's source corrections. Reviewed head `cd875d2fd585113cbb12a3ffa2f16d01912ab5a0`; exact tree `e0a1052d69511ec64aba94942969830e633d1473`. The equivalent local review commit is `8dfcd4563e0e648f90d31abcd3441861b491d735`.

**Verdict: publishable as a bounded source-backed editorial package; no remaining factual blocker in this four-document correction.**

The reviewer examined the full four-file diff, complete engineering report and E01–E09 claim mapping, owning commercial YAML wording, and cited `26b82ebc65bc2057b39dcef1499edc78308c0489` broker client availability behavior, scoped verification selection/host lease, admission failure behavior and registry-qualified PR policy. Those sources support the qualified mechanism assertions. The September 8 executor outcomes remain clearly attributed historical reports rather than an independent rerun. The unchanged authorship disclosure and proposed service remain policy/offer statements, not forensic authorship proof, sold engagements or commercial outcomes.

This is a substantive independent verdict in addition to the [claim audit](https://github.com/4444J99/limen/issues/2198#issuecomment-5602000514), not a restatement of the earlier Lite Copilot recommendation. It does not grant external publication authority, validate canonical prerequisites or complete this task without its ordinary receipt and executable acceptance gate. No task transition or marked completion receipt is asserted here.
